macros.name: datatoolasciiend
macros.doc: Does nothing but influences sorting.

macros.name: datatoolasciistart
macros.doc: Does nothing but influences sorting.

macros.name: datatoolctrlboundary
macros.doc: Does nothing but influences sorting.

macros.name: DataToolDateFmt
macros.doc: Formats the date.

macros.name: DataToolDateTimeFmt
macros.doc: Use to format timestamps (datetime date types).

macros.name: datatoolparenstart
macros.doc: Designed to indicate the start of parenthetical content, this command expands to \space normally.

macros.name: datatoolpersoncomma
macros.doc: Designed to indicate word inversion for a person, this command expands to ,\space normally.

macros.name: datatoolplacecomma
macros.doc: Designed to indicate a comma to clarify a place, this command expands to ,\space normally.

macros.name: datatoolSetCurrencySort
macros.doc: Locally redefines common currency commands to their string alternatives.

macros.name: datatoolsubjectcomma
macros.doc: Designed to indicate heading inversion (subjects, concepts and objects), this command expands to ,\space normally.

macros.name: DataToolTimeFmt
macros.doc: Formats the time.

macros.name: DataToolTimeStampFmtSep
macros.doc: This is placed between the date and time.

macros.name: DataToolTimeStampNoZoneFmt
macros.doc: Formats the date and time.

macros.name: DataToolTimeStampWithZoneFmt
macros.doc: Formats the date, time and time zone.

macros.name: DataToolTimeZoneFmt
macros.doc: Formats the time zone offset.

macros.name: dtlabs
macros.doc: Defines ⟨cs⟩ to the absolute value of ⟨num⟩.

macros.name: dtladd
macros.doc: Calculates ⟨num1⟩ + ⟨num2⟩ (addition) and stores the result in the control sequence ⟨cs⟩, where the numbers are plain numbers.

macros.name: DTLadd
macros.doc: Calculates ⟨num1⟩ + ⟨num2⟩ and stores the result in the control sequence ⟨cs⟩, where the numbers are formatted numbers.

macros.name: dtladdalign
macros.doc: Adds tabular column alignment character to ⟨cs⟩ for column ⟨col num⟩ which contains data type ⟨type⟩.

macros.name: dtladdall
macros.doc: Defines ⟨cs⟩ to the sum of all the numbers in the comma-separated list of numbers.

macros.name: DTLaddall
macros.doc: Sums all the values in ⟨num list⟩ and stores in ⟨cmd⟩ which must be a control sequence.

macros.name: DTLaddentryforrow
macros.doc: Adds the entry with key given by ⟨key⟩ and value given by ⟨value⟩ to the first row in the database ⟨db name⟩ which satisfies the condition given by ⟨condition⟩.

macros.name: dtlaftercols
macros.doc: This specifies what to put after the last column alignment specifier.

macros.name: DTLafterinitials
macros.doc: Defines what to do after the final initial.

macros.name: DTLaposinitialpunc
macros.doc: This command is used to encapsulate an initial in a word split by an apostrophe in the form ⟨head⟩'⟨tail⟩.

macros.name: dtlappendentrytocurrentrow
macros.doc: Appends an entry with the given ⟨value⟩ to \dtlcurrentrow for the column identified by ⟨col key⟩.

macros.name: DTLappendtorow
macros.doc: Appends an entry with the protected expansion of ⟨value⟩ to the current row for the column identified by ⟨col-key⟩.

macros.name: DTLassignfirstmatch
macros.doc: Applies the assignment list to the first row that has the given value in the given column.

macros.name: DTLassignlettergroup
macros.doc: Obtains the letter group from the sort value.

macros.name: dtlbeforecols
macros.doc: This specifies what to put before the first column alignment specifier.

macros.name: dtlbeforerow
macros.doc: Define token register to store everything before the current row.

macros.name: dtlbetweencols
macros.doc: This specifies what to put between the column alignment specifiers.

macros.name: DTLbetweeninitials
macros.doc: Defines what to do between initials.

macros.name: dtlbreak
macros.doc: Break out of loop at the end of current iteration.

macros.name: DTLcleardb
macros.doc: Clears the database.

macros.name: dtlclip
macros.doc: Removes redundant trailing zeros from ⟨num⟩ and stores the result in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLclip
macros.doc: Converts the formatted number to a plain number, clips it using \dtlclip and stores the result as a formatted number in the control sequence ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLcolumncount
macros.doc: Expands to the number of columns in the database identified by the label ⟨db-name⟩.

macros.name: dtlcolumnindex
macros.doc: This will expand to 0 if the database or column don’t exist, otherwise it will expand to the column index.

macros.name: dtlcompare
macros.doc: Compares ⟨string1⟩ and ⟨string2⟩, and stores the result in the count register ⟨count⟩.

macros.name: DTLcomputebounds
macros.doc: Computes the maximum and minimum x and y values over all the databases listed in ⟨db list⟩ where the x value is given by ⟨x key⟩ and the y value is given by ⟨y key⟩.

macros.name: DTLcomputebounds
macros.doc: Computes the maximum and minimum x and y values over all the databases listed in ⟨db list⟩ where the x value is given by ⟨x key⟩ and the y value is given by ⟨y key⟩.

macros.name: DTLconverttodecimal
macros.doc: Converts a formatted number ⟨num⟩ to a plain number and stores the result in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLcurr
macros.doc: This command will expand to \DTLcurr⟨ISO⟩, if defined, otherwise it will expand to ⟨ISO⟩.

macros.name: DTLcurrChar
macros.doc: Expands to the currency character associated with the currency identified by ⟨ISO⟩, or nothing if not defined.

macros.name: DTLcurrency
macros.doc: Formats ⟨value⟩ as a currency using \DTLfmtcurrency with the default currency symbol.

macros.name: dtlcurrencyformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format entries in columns with currency data type.

macros.name: DTLCurrencySymbol
macros.doc: Expands to the internal command used to store the default currency symbol.

macros.name: DTLcurrencytype
macros.doc: Data type representing currency.

macros.name: dtlcurrfmtsep
macros.doc: Separator used by currency formats.

macros.name: DTLcurrStr
macros.doc: Expands to the detokenised string value associated with currency ⟨ISO⟩ or to nothing if not defined.

macros.name: DTLcurrXXX
macros.doc: Generic currency XXX with symbol ¤.

macros.name: dtldatealign
macros.doc: Alignment character for columns containing dates.

macros.name: dtldateformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format entries in columns with date data type.

macros.name: dtldatetimealign
macros.doc: Alignment character for columns containing timestamps.

macros.name: dtldatetimeformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format entries in columns with datetime data type.

macros.name: DTLdatumcurrency
macros.doc: Expands to the currency symbol if the parsed value was a currency, otherwise expands to empty.

macros.name: DTLdatumtoDTM
macros.doc: Converts the time stamp stored in the given datum command to a datetime2 date saved with \DTMsavetimestamp, \DTMsavedate, or \DTLsavetime.

macros.name: DTLdatumtype
macros.doc: Expands to an integer representing the data type: 0 (string), 1 (integer), 2 (decimal), 3 (currency), 4 (timestamp), 5 (date), 6 (time) or -1 (unknown).

macros.name: DTLdatumvalue
macros.doc: Expands to the numeric value (as a plain number) if the parsed value was numerical, otherwise expands to empty.

macros.name: DTLdecimaltocurrency
macros.doc: This converts a decimal number into the locale dependent currency format.

macros.name: DTLdecimaltocurrency
macros.doc: This converts a decimal number into the locale dependent currency format.

macros.name: DTLdecimaltodate
macros.doc: Define command to convert a number (a Julian Day Number) into a date datum.

macros.name: DTLdecimaltodatetime
macros.doc: Define command to convert a decimal number into a datetime datum.

macros.name: DTLdecimaltolocale
macros.doc: Converts a plain number ⟨num⟩ into a formatted number and stores the result in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLdecimaltotime
macros.doc: Define command to convert a decimal number (Julian time of day fraction) into a time datum.

macros.name: DTLdefaultEURcurrencyfmt
macros.doc: The default definition is just \dtlcurrdefaultfmt but this makes it possible to vary the format of EUR specifically without affecting other currencies.

macros.name: dtldefaultkey
macros.doc: Default key to use if none specified (column index will be appended).

macros.name: DTLdefcurrency
macros.doc: Defines a new currency with associated ISO code, symbol and string equivalent.

macros.name: DTLdefcurrency
macros.doc: Defines a new currency with associated ISO code, symbol and string equivalent.

macros.name: DTLdeletedb
macros.doc: Deletes the database identified by the label ⟨db-name⟩ (that is, the internal commands associated with the database are undefined).

macros.name: dtldisplayafterhead
macros.doc: Indicates what to do after the header row, before the first row of data.

macros.name: DTLdisplaydb
macros.doc: Displays the database ⟨db⟩ in a tabular environment.

macros.name: DTLdisplaydb
macros.doc: Displays the database ⟨db⟩ in a tabular environment.

macros.name: DTLdisplaydb*
macros.doc: Displays the database ⟨db⟩ in a tabular environment.

macros.name: DTLdisplaydb*
macros.doc: Displays the database ⟨db⟩ in a tabular environment.

macros.name: DTLdisplaydbAddBegin
macros.doc: Used by \DTLdisplaydb to add the beginning of the tabular environment to the ⟨content-tlvar⟩ token list variable.

macros.name: DTLdisplaydbAddItem
macros.doc: This command is used to append an item to the ⟨content-tl-var⟩ token list variable.

macros.name: dtldisplayendtab
macros.doc: Indicates what to do just before \end{tabular}.

macros.name: DTLdisplaylongdb
macros.doc: Displays the database ⟨db⟩ in a longtable environment.

macros.name: DTLdisplaylongdb
macros.doc: Displays the database ⟨db⟩ in a longtable environment.

macros.name: DTLdisplaylongdbAddBegin
macros.doc: Analogous to \DTLdisplaydbAddBegin but used by \DTLdisplaylongdb to add the start of the longtable environment to ⟨content-tl-var⟩.

macros.name: DTLdisplaylongdbAddEnd
macros.doc: Adds the end longtable code to ⟨content-tl-var⟩ for \DTLdisplaylongdb.

macros.name: dtldisplaystarttab
macros.doc: Indicates what to do just after \begin{tabular}{⟨column specs⟩} (e.g. \hline).

macros.name: DTLdisplayTBrowidxmap
macros.doc: Provided for use with row-idx-map-function, this command expands to a row index that will arrange data rows from top to bottom instead of left to right when per-row is greater than 1.

macros.name: dtldiv
macros.doc: Divides two numbers and stores the result in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLdiv
macros.doc: Converts the formatted numbers ⟨num1⟩ and ⟨num2⟩ to plain numbers and divides them (⟨num1⟩÷ ⟨num2⟩) using \dtldiv.

macros.name: dtlfallbackaction
macros.doc: If two sort values are identical, this command is used to determine whether or not the sort function should swap the elements.

macros.name: DTLfetch
macros.doc: Fetches and displays the value for ⟨column2 name⟩ in the first row where the value of ⟨column1 name⟩ is ⟨column1 value⟩.

macros.name: DTLfetchlistelement
macros.doc: Fetches the ⟨idx⟩th element in the list and stores in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLfmtcurrency
macros.doc: Format currency using given symbol.

macros.name: dtlforcolumn
macros.doc: Iterates through column given by ⟨key⟩ in database ⟨db⟩.

macros.name: dtlforcolumn*
macros.doc: Iterates through column given by ⟨key⟩ in database ⟨db⟩.

macros.name: dtlforcolumnidx
macros.doc: Iterates through the column with index ⟨col num⟩ in database ⟨db⟩.

macros.name: dtlforcolumnidx*
macros.doc: Iterates through the column with index ⟨col num⟩ in database ⟨db⟩.

macros.name: DTLforeach
macros.doc: For each row of data in the database given by ⟨db name⟩, do ⟨text⟩, if the specified conditions are satisfied.

macros.name: DTLforeach
macros.doc: For each row of data in the database given by ⟨db name⟩, do ⟨text⟩, if the specified conditions are satisfied.

macros.name: DTLforeach*
macros.doc: For each row of data in the database given by ⟨db name⟩, do ⟨text⟩, if the specified conditions are satisfied.

macros.name: DTLforeach*
macros.doc: For each row of data in the database given by ⟨db name⟩, do ⟨text⟩, if the specified conditions are satisfied.

macros.name: dtlforeachkey
macros.doc: Iterates through all the keys in database ⟨db⟩.

macros.name: dtlforeachlevel
macros.doc: The current level register is incremented at the start of \DTLforeach and corresponds to the level index.

macros.name: DTLformatlist
macros.doc: Formats the comma-separated list supplied in its argument.

macros.name: DTLformatlist*
macros.doc: Formats the comma-separated list supplied in its argument.

macros.name: DTLgcleardb
macros.doc: Globally clears the database identified by the label ⟨db-name⟩, regardless of the global setting.

macros.name: DTLgdeletedb
macros.doc: Globally deletes the database identified by the label ⟨db-name⟩, regardless of the global setting.

macros.name: DTLget
macros.doc: This will define the (token list variable) control sequence ⟨cs⟩ to the value obtained from the most recent \DTLaction in the current scope.

macros.name: DTLget
macros.doc: This will define the (token list variable) control sequence ⟨cs⟩ to the value obtained from the most recent \DTLaction in the current scope.

macros.name: DTLgetdatatype
macros.doc: Gets data type associated with column labelled ⟨key⟩ in database ⟨db⟩ and stores in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetdatatype*
macros.doc: Gets data type associated with column labelled ⟨key⟩ in database ⟨db⟩ and stores in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetDataTypeName
macros.doc: Expands to textual label associated with the data type ⟨number⟩.

macros.name: dtlgetentryfromcurrentrow
macros.doc: This gets the value from the \dtlcurrentrow register for the column with the index ⟨col num⟩ and stores the value in the control sequence ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLGetInitialLetter
macros.doc: Obtains the first letter of ⟨text⟩ and stores it in the control sequence ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetkeyforcolumn
macros.doc: Gets the key associated with the given column index and stores in ⟨key cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetkeyforcolumn*
macros.doc: Gets the key associated with the given column index and stores in ⟨key cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetlocation
macros.doc: Assigns ⟨row cs⟩ and ⟨column cs⟩ to the indices of the first entry in ⟨database⟩ that matches ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: dtlgetrow
macros.doc: Gets row with index ⟨row idx⟩ from database named ⟨db⟩ and stores the row in \dtlcurrentrow, the preceding rows in \dtlbeforerow and the following rows in \dtlafterrow.

macros.name: DTLgetrowforkey
macros.doc: This (globally) sets ⟨cmd⟩ (a control sequence) to the first row of the database called ⟨db name⟩ which contains the key ⟨ref key⟩ that has the value ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: dtlgetrowforvalue
macros.doc: Like \dtlgetrow, but gets the row where the entry in column ⟨column index⟩ matches ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: dtlgetrowindex
macros.doc: Gets the row index for the first row in the database identified by ⟨db-name⟩ where the entry in the column given by its index ⟨col idx⟩ exactly matches the given ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetrowindex
macros.doc: Assigns ⟨row cs⟩ to the row index of the first entry in ⟨database⟩ where the entry in ⟨column index⟩ matches ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetrowindex*
macros.doc: Assigns ⟨row cs⟩ to the row index of the first entry in ⟨database⟩ where the entry in ⟨column index⟩ matches ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: DTLgetvalue
macros.doc: Gets the element in row ⟨r⟩, column ⟨c⟩ from database ⟨db⟩ and stores in ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: DTLgnewdb
macros.doc: Globally defines a new database with the label ⟨db-name⟩.

macros.name: dtlheader
macros.doc: Defined by \DTLforeachkeyinrow to the current column header.

macros.name: dtlheaderformat
macros.doc: Specifies how to format the column title.

macros.name: dtlicompare
macros.doc: Compares ⟨string1⟩ and ⟨string2⟩ and stores the result in the count register ⟨count-reg⟩, where 0 indicates the strings are the same, -1 means that ⟨string1⟩ comes before (less than) ⟨string2⟩ and 1 means that ⟨string1⟩ comes after (greater than) ⟨string2⟩ (case-insensitive) .

macros.name: DTLifaction
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the last action (within the current scope) set the return value identified by ⟨property⟩, otherwise it expands to ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifAllLowerCase
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨string⟩ contains only lowercase characters (disregarding punctuation and spaces), otherwise does ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifAllUpperCase
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨string⟩ contains only uppercase characters (disregarding punctuation and spaces), otherwise does ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifcasedatatype
macros.doc: If ⟨arg⟩ is a string, do ⟨string case⟩, if ⟨arg⟩ is an integer do ⟨int case⟩, if ⟨arg⟩ is a real number, do ⟨real case⟩, if ⟨arg⟩ is currency, do ⟨currency case⟩.

macros.name: DTLifclosedbetween
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumclosedbetween if {⟨arg⟩}, ⟨min⟩ and ⟨max⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringclosedbetween or \DTLifstringclosedbetween*.

macros.name: DTLifclosedbetween*
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumclosedbetween if {⟨arg⟩}, ⟨min⟩ and ⟨max⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringclosedbetween or \DTLifstringclosedbetween*.

macros.name: DTLifcurrency
macros.doc: Tests the first argument, if it’s currency do second argument, otherwise do third argument.

macros.name: DTLifcurrencyunit
macros.doc: This tests if ⟨arg⟩ is currency, and uses the currency unit ⟨symbol⟩.

macros.name: DTLifdate
macros.doc: Tests the first argument, if it’s a date (no time) do second argument, otherwise do third argument.

macros.name: DTLifdbempty
macros.doc: Check if named database is empty (i.e. no rows have been added).

macros.name: DTLifdbexists
macros.doc: Checks if a data base with the given name exists.

macros.name: DTLifEndsWith
macros.doc: If ⟨string⟩ ends with ⟨substring⟩, this does ⟨true part⟩, otherwise it does ⟨false part⟩.

macros.name: DTLifEndsWith*
macros.doc: If ⟨string⟩ ends with ⟨substring⟩, this does ⟨true part⟩, otherwise it does ⟨false part⟩.

macros.name: DTLifeq
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumeq if both ⟨arg1⟩ and ⟨arg2⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringeq or \DTLifstringeq*.

macros.name: DTLifeq*
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumeq if both ⟨arg1⟩ and ⟨arg2⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringeq or \DTLifstringeq*.

macros.name: DTLiffirstrow
macros.doc: Test if the current row is the first row.

macros.name: DTLifFPclosedbetween
macros.doc: Determines if ⟨min⟩ ≤ ⟨num⟩ ≤ ⟨max⟩.

macros.name: DTLifFPopenbetween
macros.doc: Determines if ⟨min⟩ < ⟨num⟩ < ⟨max⟩ where all arguments are in standard fixed point notation.

macros.name: DTLifgt
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumgt if both ⟨arg1⟩ and ⟨arg2⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringgt or \DTLifstringgt*.

macros.name: DTLifgt*
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumgt if both ⟨arg1⟩ and ⟨arg2⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringgt or \DTLifstringgt*.

macros.name: DTLifint
macros.doc: Tests the first argument, if it’s an integer do second argument, otherwise do third argument.

macros.name: DTLiflastrow
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩, if this row is the last (that satisfies the condition).

macros.name: DTLiflt
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumlt if both ⟨arg1⟩ and ⟨arg2⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringlt (unstarred version) or \DTLifstringlt* (starred version).

macros.name: DTLiflt*
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumlt if both ⟨arg1⟩ and ⟨arg2⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringlt (unstarred version) or \DTLifstringlt* (starred version).

macros.name: DTLifnull
macros.doc: Checks if ⟨command⟩ is null (either \DTLstringnull or \DTLnumbernull) if true, does ⟨true part⟩ otherwise does ⟨false part⟩.

macros.name: dtlifnumclosedbetween
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num⟩ lies between ⟨min⟩ and ⟨max⟩, including the end points (that is, ⟨min⟩ ≤ ⟨num⟩ ≤ ⟨max⟩) otherwise does ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifnumclosedbetween
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num⟩ lies between ⟨min⟩ and ⟨max⟩, including the end points (that is, ⟨min⟩ ≤ ⟨num⟩ ≤ ⟨max⟩) otherwise does ⟨false⟩, where the values are formatted numbers.

macros.name: dtlifnumeq
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num1⟩ equals ⟨num2⟩ otherwise does ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifnumeq
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num1⟩ equals ⟨num2⟩ (⟨num1⟩ = ⟨num2⟩) otherwise does ⟨false⟩, where the values are formatted numbers.

macros.name: DTLifnumerical
macros.doc: Tests the first argument, if it’s numerical do second argument, otherwise do third argument.

macros.name: dtlifnumgt
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num1⟩ is greater than ⟨num2⟩ otherwise does ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifnumgt
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num1⟩ is greater than ⟨num2⟩ (⟨num1⟩ > ⟨num2⟩) otherwise does ⟨false⟩, where the values are formatted numbers.

macros.name: dtlifnumlt
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num1⟩ is less than ⟨num2⟩ otherwise does ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifnumlt
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num1⟩ is less than ⟨num2⟩ (⟨num1⟩ < ⟨num2⟩) otherwise does ⟨false⟩, where the values are formatted numbers.

macros.name: dtlifnumopenbetween
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num⟩ lies between ⟨min⟩ and ⟨max⟩, excluding the end points (that is, ⟨min⟩ < ⟨num⟩ < ⟨max⟩) otherwise does ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifnumopenbetween
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨num⟩ lies between ⟨min⟩ and ⟨max⟩, excluding the end points (that is, ⟨min⟩ < ⟨num⟩ < ⟨max⟩) otherwise does ⟨false⟩, where the values are formatted numbers.

macros.name: DTLifoddrow
macros.doc: Determines whether the current row is odd (takes the optional argument of \DTLforeach into account.)

macros.name: DTLifopenbetween
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumopenbetween if {⟨arg⟩}, ⟨min⟩ and ⟨max⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringopenbetween or \DTLifstringopenbetween*.

macros.name: DTLifopenbetween*
macros.doc: Does \DTLifnumopenbetween if {⟨arg⟩}, ⟨min⟩ and ⟨max⟩ are numerical, otherwise do \DTLifstringopenbetween or \DTLifstringopenbetween*.

macros.name: DTLifreal
macros.doc: Parses ⟨arg⟩ and does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨arg⟩ is a real (decimal) formatted number or is in scientific notation, otherwise it does ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: DTLifstring
macros.doc: Tests the first argument, if it’s a string do second argument, otherwise do third argument.

macros.name: DTLifstringclosedbetween
macros.doc: Does ⟨true⟩ if ⟨str⟩ is lexicographically between ⟨min⟩ and ⟨max⟩, inclusive.

macros.name: DTLifstringclosedbetween*
